newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ends quiet day mostly lower, in range.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ends quiet day mostly lower, in range.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures ended a dull session mostly lower on speculators' liquidation but remained in a trading range.
July closed down 12 stg at 1,026 stg per tonne, off its session low of 1,019. September lost nine to 1,044. Total volume stood at 3,585 contracts, with July grabbing 1,480.
Traders said technicals drove the day's activity. They said speculators were liquidating long positions established late last week. Uncovered open interest gained 1,874 lots as of Friday's close.
Speculators were probably disappointed prices did not continue climbing after Thursday and Friday's gains, traders said.
New York's weak close on Friday and opening weakness on Monday due to a flurry of speculative liquidation there also dampened enthusaism.
Some traders said light arbitrage-related selling in the nearbys surfaced in the afternoon as spreads widened.

Despite the losses, London's July contract remained in a wide range between about 1,046 and 1,013, with some traders targeting a close below 1,019 as negative. If July closes below 1,019, some expected a retest of a support base near 1,000.

Some traders expected further losses in cocoa to emerge as speculators continued to liquidate long positions both here and in New York. Speculative pressures are expected to surface in New York before first notice day in a couple of weeks to lead the way lower.
Origin sales perched on top of any rallies were also expected to stymie gains, traders said.
But technically, some traders were still looking at a small uptrend in July. They said July still looked promising because it continued to hold an uptrend channel line on charts.
In options, 120 July 1,000 calls changed hands in the afternoon.
